    queue = deque([(start, 0)])

        node, depth = queue.popleft()

            nodes_at_target_depth.add(node)

def bfs_at_depth(graph, start, target_depth):
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    nodes_at_target_depth = set()
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            nodes_at_target_depth.add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:

                # For BFS at exact depth, we don't mark visited in the traditional way

                if (neighbor, depth + 1) not in visited:

    visited = set([start])

    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    nodes_at_target_depth = set()
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            nodes_at_target_depth.add(node)

def bfs_at_depth(graph, start, target_depth):
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    nodes_at_target_depth = set()
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            nodes_at_target_depth.add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:

                # For BFS at exact depth, we don't mark visited in the traditional way

                if (neighbor, depth + 1) not in visited:

def bfs_at_depth(graph, start, target_depth):
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    nodes_at_target_depth = set()
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            nodes_at_target_depth.add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:
            for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
                # For BFS at exact depth, we don't mark visited in the traditional way

                if (neighbor, depth + 1) not in visited:

    queue = deque([(start, 0)])

    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])

        node, depth = queue.popleft()

def bfs_at_depth(graph, start, target_depth):
    visited = set([start])
    queue = deque([(start, 0)])
    nodes_at_target_depth = set()
    
    while queue:
        node, depth = queue.popleft()
        
        if depth == target_depth:
            nodes_at_target_depth.add(node)
            continue  # Don't explore further from target depth
        
        if depth < target_depth:

                # For BFS at exact depth, we don't mark visited in the traditional way

                if (neighbor, depth + 1) not in visited:
